# Authentication & Delivery Requirements Checklist: API Authentication

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the authentication, invitation, recovery and delivery requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are account-state rules (active, suspended) defined for every flow that depends on them: sign-in, recovery request, recovery completion, invitation acceptance, password change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required contents of the invitation and recovery emails specified (link, sender identity, assigned role, expiry statement) beyond "an email with the link is sent"? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 Are session lifetime rules complete: is an absolute maximum lifetime defined in addition to "7 days of inactivity", and is the extension rule ("extended on use") bounded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Are input validation and failure outputs defined for the bootstrap administrator command (email format, password policy, duplicate administrator)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the throttled response specified precisely (status code, how the wait time is conveyed, units) rather than "states the wait time"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, US1 scenario 6, contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK006 Are retention or cleanup requirements defined for accepted, revoked and expired invitation records and for used recovery tokens? [Gap]
- [x] CHK007 Are the security events enumerated exhaustively with the fields each record must carry, including invitation revocation and failed password change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "client address" defined for a deployment behind the Web BFF: which hop's address counts, and what the requirement is when no forwarded address is present? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, Plan R5]
- [x] CHK009 Is "indistinguishable" in FR-003 quantified across status code, body, headers and response timing so that SC-004 can be assessed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Is the invitation and recovery link format specified (receiving application, public base URL, token placement) given that the web application is out of scope? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Is the single-role model of the spec stated as a constraint on the stored role (one role per user, no multiple roles)? [Clarity, Spec Key Entities → Role]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 Do the Clarifications entry (20 failed attempts) and FR-017 (20 requests per endpoint) agree after the planning adjustment, with no stale wording left in user stories? [Conflict, Spec Clarifications, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK013 Are US4 scenario 1 ("current session continues") and FR-021 reconciled with a provider that ends all sessions and issues a fresh one to the caller? [Consistency, Spec US4, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK014 Do the invitation status sets agree across the spec (pending, accepted, revoked, expired), the data model (expired derived at read time) and the OpenAPI `Invitation.status` enum? [Consistency, Spec Key Entities, data-model.md, contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK015 Is one error response shape (the standard Nest `HttpException` body) specified consistently for every endpoint? [Consistency, contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK016 Do FR-012 (administrators only) and the contract's security requirements and 403 responses align for create, list and revoke? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK017 Is FR-004 (sessions ended at suspension) consistent with the assumption that user management, including suspension, is out of scope for this feature? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can SC-001 and SC-002 (completion times for acceptance and recovery) be measured within this feature's scope, which excludes the web client? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK019 Is SC-006 ("zero critical or high findings") tied to a named scanner, a severity source and an exception process for accepted risks? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, §DR-003]
- [x] CHK020 Is SC-007 ("under 5 minutes from a clean checkout") defined with a reference environment or network assumptions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK021 Does DR-006 define how each functional requirement and edge case is traced to a test, so that SC-005 can be checked objectively? [Measurability, Spec §DR-006, §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for an invitation accepted while another user's session is active, including an invitation email that differs from the session's email? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are recovery requirements defined for an email that has a pending invitation but no account (generic response, no email, invitation unaffected)? [Gap, Coverage]
- [x] CHK024 Are email-delivery-failure requirements complete for invitation creation and for recovery, including what the administrator sees and what is logged? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Is the expiry boundary rule (expiry moment exclusive) stated for recovery tokens as it is for invitations? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK026 Are concurrency requirements defined for two simultaneous acceptances of one invitation and two simultaneous completions of one recovery link? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for sign-in by a user with an active invitation-created account whose invitation was later revoked (revocation after acceptance has no effect)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements (delivery)

- [x] CHK028 Is DR-001 specific enough to accept one base image and reject another (glibc vs musl, shell presence, digest pinning, non-root user id)? [Clarity, Spec §DR-001]
- [x] CHK029 Does DR-002 define what is recorded for build time and image size (baseline, measurement method, acceptable change)? [Measurability, Spec §DR-002]
- [x] CHK030 Does DR-004 define the pinning scope (root and application manifests, Node, pnpm, base images) and the upgrade procedure? [Completeness, Spec §DR-004]
- [x] CHK031 Does DR-005 name every resource kind that must carry the project-specific name (containers, volumes, network) and the host port strategy? [Clarity, Spec §DR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is the assumption that the API is reachable only through a trusted proxy (required for per-address limiting) stated in the spec rather than only in the plan? [Assumption, Plan R5, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK033 Are outbound mail requirements documented (connection timeout, retry policy, what is logged on failure, no secrets in logs)? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference

- Evaluated on 2026-10-11 at the reviewer's request against spec.md, plan.md, data-model.md, contracts/ and tasks.md after the `/speckit-analyze` remediation; gaps found during the evaluation (FR-004, FR-006, FR-016, FR-019, DR-001…DR-006, SC-001/002/004/007, Key Entities, Edge Cases, Assumptions) were closed in spec.md before marking.
